title: Writing Formal Submissions to Public Bodies
grammar: Institutional formulaic case government in formal petitions (hivatkozással valamire, eleget téve)
goal: I can draft a formal administrative submission (hivatalos beadvány / kérelem) adhering to official Hungarian conventions.
I can master institutional formulaic case government in petitions (hivatkozással a törvényre, eleget téve a felszólításnak).
I can structure statements of facts (tényállás), legal arguments, attachments, and polite bureaucratic closing formulas.
